scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tests/browser && tsc -p core/cloudflare/tsconfig.json && tsc -p core/cloudflare/auth/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:worker && npm run test:segments && npm run test:logic && npm run test:pglite && playwright test
scripts.test:pglite: esbuild tests/pglite-core.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --loader:.sql=text --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=.local/pglite-core.test.mjs && node --test .local/pglite-core.test.mjs
scripts.deploy:demo: npm run build:demo && node scripts/deploy.mjs demo
scripts.deploy:playpen: npm run build:playpen && node scripts/deploy.mjs playpen
scripts.check:cloudflare: node scripts/deploy.mjs demo --dry-run && node scripts/deploy.mjs playpen --dry-run
scripts.package:cloudflare: npm run build:cloudflare && sh scripts/package-cloudflare.sh pack
scripts.test:worker: node --experimental-strip-types --test --test-concurrency=1 core/cloudflare/worker.test.ts core/cloudflare/signing.test.ts core/cloudflare/contract.test.ts core/cloudflare/oauth.test.ts core/cloudflare/auth/auth.test.ts
